attributes.law_screen: Screened all 17 core-screen laws before and during the pass. offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web (PRIMARY, applied ~215x): the whole-TU base lever, single-additive-expression offsetof on the original raw pointer, zero type changes. lwzu-idiom-web-retention: screened and respected -- every pl/p/entry/item/it2/b28/b24/b240/lvl base kept its original u8* type throughout; never introduced a typed intermediate on an lwzu-adjacent web (do_shopping's cursor-field pl+2664 site, capped/STRUCTURAL, converted via offsetof only and stayed at its exact prior real/fuzzy). multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing + declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast: screened -- avoided typed aliases for every walked/indexed multi-field base (the pl+r*16 PlayerPowerup array in do_shopping, the b28/stats per-character shop-stat records); used offsetof-form exclusively there per the boundary laws' explicit recommendation, never a typed cast or declared alias. offsetof-fused-immediate-counter: applied for the pl+r*16+offsetof(Player,powerup[0].field) walked-pointer sub-field forms. write-site-alias-defeats-reload-parity: screened -- the powerup array writes stayed as independent offsetof expressions on raw pl, no declared alias introduced. pointer-walk-array-index-regression: screened -- do_shop's accumulator-walked `pl += 13148` loop kept its raw-pointer offsetof form throughout, never converted to array indexing. recomputed-index-array-form-safe: applied once (shop_show_lv's `lbl_80122F30[*(s32*)pl]`, a freshly-recomputed single-field index, not an accumulator) -- byte-identical, and the site now fully vanishes from the cast-deref census (279 total sites vs 281 before, both still-EXACT reads of the same table). offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary: screened, not triggered -- no site in this pass based an offsetof on an array-typed struct MEMBER access (array-to-pointer decay); every base was a plain pointer local/parameter. offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier: respected -- gated every batch (9 separate defake_gate.py check --rebuild runs across the pass) rather than spot-checking, which is exactly how the whole-TU-cascade below was caught instead of silently landing. walked-base-symbol-identity: screened -- confirmed via the existing shopquery.c/player.c convention that the shared symbol stays `gPlayers` (u8[] extern in shopquery.c's Matching pin) with no dual-symbol ambiguity for any site touched. scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form, swap-loop-is-record-layout-ground-truth, dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe/needs-isolated-accumulator, large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression, offsetof-overturns-typed-alias-caps: none applicable -- no matching pattern (no lfsu-adjacent read/write pair touched, no swap loop in scope, no shadow-offset deletion performed, every function far under the 4000-insn fuzzy-arbitration threshold, no prior typed-alias cap revisited). A SIXTH, previously unrecorded hazard was discovered and is proposed alongside this record as claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade.20260831.v1: adding a new struct-typed (not scalar) member to the shared Player.h header regresses multiple unrelated functions TU-wide even when unused; it was caught by the batch-gating discipline above, bisected, and worked around by moving the two speculative per-character record types (PlayerShopStat, PlayerClassExpCkpt) to shop.c-local typedefs instead of Player.h members -- final state has zero Player.h struct-typed additions, only 8 new scalar fields (7 in the 0x0A64 block + field_224C).
attributes.sites_left_raw: 59 remaining bare sites (56 genuine + 2 false-positive census matches on `X * (f64)(...)`/`X * (f32)(...)` chained-cast multiplication in shop_show_final_stats' secs computation and calc_shop_ypos's y computation -- neither is an actual pointer dereference, both pre-date this pass and are unchanged). The 56 genuine remaining sites are ALL in the per-player/per-item scratch draw-layout buffer at lbl_802897D0 ('page' in most functions, 'tbl' in show_piles/fn_8009A0AC) and lbl_80122ED0 ('dpage' in show_gold, 'tbl' in shop_setup): parallel flat arrays at 4/12/24/60/256/768-byte per-player strides (item-blit pointers, availability flags, cursor/scroll state, per-pile rank/target/current/raw-value tables, name-blit textures). This TU's OWN header comment (lines 54-59) already documents this as explicitly DEFERRED project policy: 'the GC equivalents live in the lbl_80344C00..lbl_80344C18 sbss cluster + lbl_803448xx and the coordinate tables listed above; left under lbl_ names until pinned individually' -- not attempted this pass, consistent with that note and with time/risk budget; a follow-up pass could name the four per-player 3-slot arrays (offsets 80/128/176/224 off a col*12 stride, consistently reused across show_piles/show_gold/fn_8009A0AC) as a first target since their field roles are already evidenced by this session's reading.
attributes.struct_discoveries: Extended include/game/player.h with 8 GC-verified SCALAR fields (no struct-typed additions, see the cascade law): 0x0A64 field_A64 (shop-screen state-machine mode, do_shop's case-switch driver), 0x0A68 field_A68 (shop item-list cursor index -- matches the pre-existing local DSPlayerView.field_A68 name from the prior pass, now also a real Player field), 0x0A6C field_A6C (staged-reveal UI timer shared by do_shop/shop_show_lv/shop_show_final_stats), 0x0A70/0x0A74/0x0A78/0x0A7C field_A70..field_A7C (displayed-attribute snapshots for the level-up stat-reveal animation, f32 att_fight/armor/magic/speed shadows) -- these 7 fields exactly fill the previously-opaque pad_0A64[0x1C] with zero leftover bytes, verified by direct arithmetic before editing. 0x224C field_224C (per-character(*240) gold checkpoint read by fn_8009A0AC, splits pad_223A). Also identified but declined to embed in Player.h (moved to shop.c-local types instead, per the cascade law): a stride-0x1C 'now'/'checkpoint' shop pile-stat record pair at absolute pl+3088 and pl+8284 (fields at relative +0/+16/+20/+24, the last three used only by shop_show_final_stats' playtime breakdown, the first two also read by fn_8009A0AC's end-of-level gain calc) and a stride-0x18 per-character exp-checkpoint record at pl+7900 (field 0 only, read via ExpToLevel). Wired shop.c to the pre-existing include/game/leveldata.h level_data struct (not previously included in this TU) for fn_8009A0AC's shop_maxgold/shop_maxkills/shop_maxexp fields at gCurLevel+224/228/232 -- a clean cross-reference to already-verified data confirming the raw2/raw3 deltas are exactly 'kills this level' and 'exp this level'.
